title: Semi-representable hypercovers give étale hypercovers
statement: If K is a simplicial object of X.Etale and its singleton formal-coproduct image is a semi-representable hypercover, then K satisfies the ordinary étale hypercover condition with matching objects tested on all schemes over X.

proof.text: Use sr_matching_object_one_member to obtain proper-face matching cones and the equivalence between the SR hypercover condition and surjectivity of their matching arrows. Reflect the limiting property from schemes over X to the etale category. The canonical lower-simplex matching scheme has a limiting proper-face cone by properConeIsLimit; uniqueness of limits gives an isomorphism from the singleton matching scheme to it. Equality of their matching arrows follows by composing with each proper-face projection. Transport surjectivity along this isomorphism, then apply isEtaleHypercover_of_matchingCover. This works also in degree zero: both cones are limits of the empty diagram, so the same limit-uniqueness argument applies.

proof_origin.place: Proved by singleton comparison, properConeIsLimit, and isEtaleHypercover_of_matchingCover; second reader H2
